== Summary ==
Identified: none. Friday-night team tournament, table 40. Left front: glasses, a beard, a black graphic tee, and headphones around the neck. Left: short dark hair and a grey tee. Right, reaching across the table: long hair in a ponytail, a blue tee, and sunglasses on the head (not [[Emil Wallin]], whose 2015 and 2018 portraits show a blonde undercut). Right front: a full beard and a navy shirt with a starship print. Other tables in the background. Faces unlabeled.
The Friday-night team tournament (32 players), table 40.
